title: AI's New Problem: Too Powerful, Too Unsupervised, Too Dangerous
description:
AI agents are like interns. Powerful, fast — and dangerously unsupervised without the right oversight.

In this episode of Human Layer AI, Aakarsh Sharma returns with Aariz Sajan, B2B AI systems expert from Kenya, to go deeper on AI governance, the hallucination problem, and why human intuition still beats AI probability.

Aariz breaks down Singapore's AI governance framework, agent-to-agent protocols, and why the lowered barrier to AI entry is creating more chaos than clarity for businesses.

What you'll learn:
• Why the lower barrier to AI entry is backfiring for many businesses
• How to manage AI agents the same way you'd manage junior employees
• The vicious cycle of AI hallucinations and how misinformation compounds
• What Singapore's AI governance framework gets right about accountability
• Why human intuition and judgment still outperforms AI in high-stakes decisions
